content: Opâ ruac râsi tuŋke-jarembiŋ
Eme dameŋ ijaha Jerusalem haeonec opâ ruac kikefuŋ râsi sâko fuŋke-jarembiŋ. Ejarepie wiserâ râwiŋ qâwiŋ erâ Judaia â Samaria mâreŋko rafârembiŋ. Aposolo jaŋe sawa getâc-jopapie jumbiŋ.
Eme ŋic mitine gâcne jaŋe Stefano duckerâ kio mamakuc ecnembiŋ.
Saulo eki ine opâ ruac ima bacjoparâ ficne ficne ferâ ro fârec ejarehuc kâpâcwâru ficko râec-jopahuc domawec.
Filipozi Samaria haeo miti gie bawec
Opâ ruac bâtâtiec-jopakicne jaŋe ine hae sâc juhuc ŋic miti jaza rambiŋ.
Eku Filipozi Samaria ŋic jaŋere hae qizecko fisirâ Kristore biŋedâŋ jazawec.
Jazame ŋic guru sâko jaŋe dâŋticnere ejareme mana aŋac embiŋ. Ehuc mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bame honembiŋ.
E demoŋ bocjaha jâpe-jareme ŋicmaŋkonec wefurâ owackehuc wisembiŋ. Erâ wâc šeke puriŋ â kike demba bocjaha sahac ɋiɋic bacjopawec.
Eme irec hae ira šeri kâcɋene fuawec.
Eme hae ijaha qaŋgec bapa moc juwec, šâŋene Simoŋ. E jahacnere no ŋic fekicne muhuc qaŋgec gie bame Samaria ŋicguru jaŋe honepie bipinehec ewec.
Ehuc fekicne wahakicne jaŋe ere manapie fefene eme šiŋuc mujumbieŋ: “Ŋic kecšizi Anuture tâpiri, Sokawec Sâko mucnekicne, irec hozine hâcne.”
Eme qaŋgec-ticnezi maŋ bâsifuc ejarewecte dameŋ šora erao qohotahuc jumbiŋ.
Juhapie Filipozi Anuture uucmaŋte Biŋebiaŋ â Jesu Kristore dâŋ binaŋ Jazame mana šakierâ ŋic â ŋokac mâmâc Miti Opâ ruambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Simoŋ e iŋuc jaha miti mana šakierâ opâ ruarâ Filipore maŋfuŋko juwec, ehuc mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bame hone warec mâretec ehuc juwec.
Petoro â Johane Samaria haeo rapic
Eme Samaria ŋicguru jaŋe Anuture dâŋ ro maŋ epie irec biŋe Jerusalem haeo aposolo jaŋerao rame manambiŋ. Ehuc Petoro â Johane sorec-jofapie rapic.
Ra fisirâ jaŋe Tiri Mârohec eniŋte Wofuŋ numucnepic.
Juwicnao Tiri Mârozi jaŋerao mi wahawec, jaŋe mâc Jesure šâŋeo šuhuckehuc Miti Opâ sawa ruambiŋ.
Eme aposolo jahe mejekic qizec-jeŋicko râepire jaŋe Tiri Mârohec embiŋ.
Simoŋ e Tiri Mâro furine baocte muwec
Aposolo jahe ŋic jaŋere qizec faio mejekic râepire Tiri Mârohec epie Simoŋzi honerâ jaherao moneŋ amecke fisirâ
šiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe tâpiri i no iŋuc jaha narepire ŋic mocte qizecko menane râepe Tiri Mârohec ezejec.”
Mume Petorozi šiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Anuture jauŋ moneŋzi furine bazo mukomecte moneŋgezi gohec mâmâc sisipiricko razac me¡
Anutuzi maŋsiocge honekacte tâpiri šizi moc mi hehuŋgaŋguhame mâc jâmbâŋ jucmu.
Go bâbâsifucge qikiŋnehuc maŋge bârisierâ Wofuŋ numucnetec maŋgao andac sâko bâtâmire-garezejec.
Go sâqocne hâtânezi hariŋguekac hâcne.”
Eme Simoŋzi šiŋuc muwec: “Ŋohe ŋahac nore erâ Wofuŋ numucnepire akicnuha wiac mukopirec i mi fua-narezejec.”
Eme aposolo jahe ŋic ŋokac Wofuŋte dâŋ jaza sanaŋkerâ Jerusalem haeo risiepic. Risiehuc Samaria hae bocjaha Biŋebiaŋ jaza jaza rapic.
Filipozi Africa ŋic moc miti âzâcnewec
Wofuŋte aŋelo moczi Filipo šiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Go šawierâ juwickopec, Jerusalem haeonec Gaza haeo hueŋgopieŋ hata ira razemec.” Hata i mâreŋ tuhuo fokac.
Iŋuc muhuc âzâcneme Filipozi šawierâ rawec. Eme Etiopia mâreŋko ŋokac wofuŋ juwec, šâŋene Kandake, ere ŋicbomboŋ â moneŋ mafa soŋaŋ sâko eki Jerusalem haeo Anutu mai ecneocte rafeweckonec
risieocte keretacko rahuc porofete Jesaja ere dâŋqâreŋ wosewec.
Iŋuc ehame Mârozi Filipo šiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go ra keretac kecocni bâfuac.”
Mume Filipozi ra bâfuarâ ŋic e porofete Jesaja ere dâŋqâreŋ wosehame manarâ wiocnewec, “Dâŋ wosekomec irec fuŋne manakic me?”
Eme eki muwec, “Moczi mi nazahame nahackoaŋ wemocko sâcne manapemu?” Iŋuc murâ Filipo âzâcneme keretacko ferâ qâteme ŋepic.
Dâŋqâreŋ wosewec ine kecšiŋuc:

content.text: me kanšaŋ bâbâtâc ŋic erao fâsâerâ foekac,
iŋuc hâcne micticne moc mi aŋkewec.
Bâpitiwambiŋko kiŋ babatara i erao tarawec.

content: Eme ŋicbomboŋ e Filipo šiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Go mutec manape, porofete e more iŋuc mukac, e jahacnere me ŋic mocte?
Eme Filipo e porofetere dâŋko iticnehuc Jesure Biŋebiaŋ âzâcnewec.
Iŋuc ehuc raku opâo fisipic. Eme ŋicbomboŋzi muwec, “Honec, opâ fokac ši” Miti Opâre mupe sâcne rua-narecmu me?” [
Eme Filipozi muwec, “Dâŋ gazapac i maŋ hâcbuc mana šakiekomecko sâcne eene.” Eme dâŋ šiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Jesu Kristo e Anuture Ŋokâ i mana šakiekopac.”Ý
Iŋuc murâ keretac bâniniŋkerâ Filipo â ŋicbomboŋ opâo hupic. Hurâ Filipozi ruacnewec.
Eme opâonec wefupire Wofuŋte Mârozi Filipo jowa rame ŋicbomboŋzi mocwâc mi honehuc bubiaŋko hata-ticnao rawec.
Filipo eki ine Asidode haeo fisime honembiŋ. Erâ irecnec fuŋkerâ haene haene miti jaza raku Kaisarea hae bâfuawec.
